verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Public API with Basic Auth and OAuth, endpoint references, webhooks, and code tutorials, but nothing mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Raw REST API access is an adjacent building block, not the SDK capability the story asks for. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a SaaS telephony platform, so with no evidence the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
